text.en:
Upon dealing Melee Damage while an Enemy is within 15 meters:
<pve 500% /> <pvp [100%] /> increased damage and +100 Handling for 10 seconds or until firing a full burst.

4 second cooldown after buff expires. Can be activated while stowed.

Any Powered Melee which requires sprinting, sliding, or performs a slam will not activate Blunt Execution Rounds.

enhanced (
#e Buff duration is increased to 11 seconds.
)

text.zh-chs:
对 15 米范围内的敌人造成近战伤害后：
提升 <pve 500% /> <pvp [100%] /> 伤害，并 +100 操控性，持续 10 秒或直到下次射击。

4 秒冷却时间。武器在收起时也可触发。

需要冲刺或滑行的充能近战以及弹道猛击均不会触发该特性。

enhanced (
#e 增益持续时间增加到 11 秒。
)
